scope: Direct visual comparison of the three printed soprano lyric systems against provisional stanza-one anchor draft.

observations.notes: Printed text starts with കൂ ടെ പാ ർക്ക and continues through the first part of കൂരിരുളേറുന്നു.
Printed lyric units continue the preceding word and end partway through വേരില്ലാ.
Printed line ends at the final cadence.

limitations: Printed lyric-unit counts and sequence can be compared visually, but precise glyph-to-note positions, Malayalam transcription fidelity, musical durations and other stanzas need separate verification. Do not treat 40 matching printed fragments as 40 independently verified musical anchors.
